title: Finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$: valuation ring, uniformizer and finite quotients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime number and $\mathbf Q_\ell$ the field of $\ell$-adic numbers with its absolute value $|\cdot|_\ell$ and valuation ring $\mathbf Z_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. A *finite extension* of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ is a field extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pc-field-extension] such that $E$ is finite-dimensional as a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space; its degree is $[E:\mathbf Q_\ell]=\dim_{\mathbf Q_\ell}E$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. For such $E$ the following data are defined.

1. *The absolute value* $|\cdot|_E$: the unique absolute value on $E$ whose restriction to $\mathbf Q_\ell$ is $|\cdot|_\ell$; it exists, is unique and is nonarchimedean by [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value]. $E$ is complete for it [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-complete].
2. *The valuation ring* (ring of integers) and its maximal ideal

$$
\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|_E\leq1\},\qquad\mathfrak m_E=\{x\in E:|x|_E<1\}.
$$

By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr], $\mathcal O_E$ is a subring of $E$ and a discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_E$ and finite *residue field* $k_E=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E$.
3. *A uniformizer* of $E$: an element $\varpi_E\in\mathcal O_E$ with $\varpi_E\mathcal O_E=\mathfrak m_E$. Uniformizers exist, they are the nonzero elements of $\mathfrak m_E$ of largest absolute value, any two differ by a unit of $\mathcal O_E$, and every $x\in E^\times$ is uniquely $u\,\varpi_E^m$ with $u\in\mathcal O_E^\times$, $m\in\mathbf Z$ [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr]. One uniformizer $\varpi_E$ is chosen.
4. *The finite coefficient rings*: for every integer $n\geq1$ the quotient ring

$$
A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E,
$$

and the *transition homomorphism* $A_{E,n+1}\to A_{E,n}$ induced by the identity of $\mathcal O_E$ (well defined since $\varpi_E^{n+1}\mathcal O_E\subseteq\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$). By [lem-weil-valued-dvr-finite-quotients], applied to $E$, $|\cdot|_E$ and $\varpi_E$ (its hypotheses hold by [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value] and [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr]), $A_{E,n}$ is a finite local ring, the transition homomorphisms are surjective, and $\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E=\mathfrak m_E^n$, so $A_{E,n}$ does not depend on the choice of $\varpi_E$.

split_report.summary: The definition asserted six facts as part of the data (unique extension of $|\cdot|_\ell$ and the norm formula, completeness, $\mathcal O_E$ a discrete valuation ring with finite residue field and the description of uniformizers and of $E^\times$, $\mathcal O_E$ the integral closure of $\mathbf Z_\ell$, $A_{E,n}$ finite local with surjective transitions independent of $\varpi_E$). The statement now keeps only the data ($|\cdot|_E$, $\mathcal O_E$, $\mathfrak m_E$, $k_E$, a chosen uniformizer, $A_{E,n}$ and the transition maps) and cites each fact as a statement node: lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value, lem-weil-l-adic-extension-complete and lem-weil-valued-dvr-finite-quotients are Mathlib leaves (spectral norm: spectralNorm_unique_field_norm_ext, spectralMulAlgNorm, spectralNorm.completeSpace; Valued.integer.finite_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow_of_finite_residueField); lem-weil-l-adic-extension-norm-formula, lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr and lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integral-closure are searched and not in Mathlib (Mathlib has IsNonarchimedeanLocalField with DVR and finite-residue-field instances, but no instance for ℚ_[p] or its finite extensions, and no IsLocalField), so they join the queue. A new definition leaf def-weil-field-norm (Algebra.norm) is used by the norm formula. The stmt_deps now name def-pc-field-extension and def-weil-vector-space-dimension, which the statement uses. The source (Serre, Local Fields, Ch. II §2) is wanted and not in literature/; the new statement nodes have no proofs, as for any new node. (Lead, review: the norm formula and the integral-closure clause are not needed by the definition and not in the blueprint; removed with their two new nodes before commit.)
